## Resource templates

| URI template | Required scopes |
|---|---|
| `hostdeck://devices/{device_id}/status` | `devices:read` |
| `hostdeck://devices/{device_id}/jobs/{job_id}` | `jobs:read` |
| `hostdeck://devices/{device_id}/artifacts/{artifact_id}` | `artifacts:read` |
| `hostdeck://devices/{device_id}/events` | `devices:read`, `jobs:read` |

## Prompts

- `hostdeck_computer_task`: Plan authorized work on one device.
- `hostdeck_diagnose_job`: Diagnose an owned job from authorized evidence.
- `hostdeck_edit_document`: Prepare a format-preserving authorized document edit.

The full manager opens only through an explicitly requested
`hostdeck_open_manager` call and its advertised `ui://hostdeck/management/v2`
resource. Ordinary calls do not open it. The obsolete unversioned resource
is refused by the current server. Source metadata does not prove host rendering.
